findings.title: Wiping cloths: properly used and stored.
findings.citation_text:
3-304.14(B) Wiping Cloths, Use Limitation. (B) Cloths in-use for wiping counters and other EQUIPMENT surfaces shall be: (1) Held between uses in a chemical sanitizer solution at a concentration specified under § 4-501.114.

During the inspection two separate locations were observed with moist wiping cloths stored on counters between uses. These items were shown to the PIC and moved to the sani bucket to correct. Ensure that all sanitizer wiping cloths are stored between uses in a sanitizer solution of effective concentration to prevent pathogenic organisms proliferation.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

1) Multiple pans are observed washed and with remaining stickers on the bottoms. The PIC was instructed to ensure that the stickers are removed prior to or during the washing process to ensure that they do not provide for possible mold growth on the food contact surfaces. The items were moved back to dish to correct. 2) Three knives on the magnetic strip were observed with food debris on them. The PIC was shown and moved the items to dish for cleaning. Ensure that all food contact surfaces are cleaned after use and prior to storage in the facility.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-201.13(A) Floor and Wall Junctures, Coved, and Enclosed or Sealed. (A) In FOOD ESTABLISHMENTS in which cleaning methods other than water flushing are used for cleaning floors, the floor and wall junctures shall be coved and closed to no larger than 1 mm (one thirty-second inch). 

The coving in the section of the facility where the chest freezers and standing freezer are located was observed with a gap along the top section where it meets the wall. The PIC was shown and instructed to re-seal the coving to the wall prior to the next routine inspection. Ensure that all coving is correctly sealed to the walls at all times.

findings.title: Food separated and protected.
findings.comment: Inspector observed chicken being stored in plastic grocery bags in the walk-in cooler. Discussed with PIC and PIC removed chicken from grocery bag. Ensure that meat is stored in food safe bags.
findings.citation_text: 3-302.11 Packaged and Unpackaged Food - Separation, Packaging, and Segregation. (A) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination during storage.
